description: This file defines API routes for managing multiplayer Tic Tac Toe games using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, joining, leaving, playing moves, and retrieving game state, as well as internal helper functions for game logic.

methods.name: create_game(_: GameCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new game and adds the creator as the first player.

methods.name: join_game(body: GameJoin, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Allows a user to join an existing waiting game as the second player.

methods.name: leave_game(body: GameLeave, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Removes the current user from the game they are in.

methods.name: play_move(body: MoveCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Processes a move made by a player, updates game state, and checks for winners or draws.

methods.name: get_game(game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified game.

methods.name: _find_winner(board)
methods.description: Determines if the current board state has a winner.

methods.name: _to_game_read(game, db, players=None)
methods.description: Constructs a GameRead response object from game and related data.

ctags.name: create_game
ctags.pattern: /^def create_game(_: GameCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (_: GameCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))

ctags.pattern: /^def join_game(body: GameJoin, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (body: GameJoin, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))

ctags.pattern: /^def leave_game(body: GameLeave, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (body: GameLeave, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))

ctags.pattern: /^def play_move(body: MoveCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (body: MoveCreate, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
